# Errand - Open the Fourth Lock

## Status

Completed in Session 2.

## Overview

Clear the jammed fourth gate so the lock stair could be worked again.

## Objectives Completed

- [x] Open the sluice
- [x] Remove the wedge

12 marks each, from the lock fee the crew was owed.
